name: dev4: single CBF optimisation filter vs the final-test filter, closed loop (Alliance clusters)
written: 2026-10-15 ~21:00, before any dev4 episode was run
motivation: Offline (75 risky dev decisions, results/program_b/cbf_qp/cbfopt_report_b50.json) the single CBF optimisation without hand-made primitives lowered real risk 27.6% -> 12.4% vs 13.8% for the final-test selection filter. This checks it in closed loop.
setting: as the final test: normal mass, 2x execution noise, HARD_OFF, per-episode seeds; every episode runs all three arms in ONE cluster job (same GPU, same software), container torch 2.9 + MuJoCo 3.13 (CPU rendering)

arms.cbf: final-test filter: closedloop_v1 model_US, trigger = barrier or regime check, fix = closest safe of 15 policy samples + 3 primitives
arms.cbfopt: new filter: cf_v1 model_CF (O_MAX recalibrated label-free: results/jenga/cbf_calibration_CF.json), same trigger rule, fix = eval/cbf_opt.optimise (path bends + speed, starts = policy plan + 7 policy samples, relative disturbance barrier alpha 0.5, 10 Adam steps, 16 futures, exact fork check in the choice); no primitives

metrics: neighbour topples, success (3 cm lift without topple), prevented/caused vs record, one-sided McNemar vs record, interventions, seconds per intervention
decision_rule: cbfopt is taken to a fresh pre-registered final test if it has at least 3 fewer topples than cbf AND success >= cbf success - 5. If it has fewer topples but by less than 3, report it as 'not distinguishable on 150 episodes' and decide with the user. Otherwise the final-test filter stays. dev4 numbers are never reported as a test result.
